whatsapp.content: leo? you okay? you didnt reply all day
yeah sorry. long day. the move and everything
the boys keep asking about you. thiago says he misses his room 😢
i miss it too. but we'll be okay. promise ❤️
how was training? did the teammates treat you well?
good. theyre nice guys. mbappe passed me the ball a few times. that kid is fast
haha classic you. always talking about football. and the boys? you miss them?
yeah. so much. give them a big kiss from me. im coming home tomorrow
babe, mateo has a fever. 101.5
whats the doctor saying? im heading there now
havent gone yet. was waiting for you to tell me what to do. i know youre busy but
nothing is more important. take me there. leaving right now
watched the game. amazing goal baby 🥰
thanks. that one was for you and the boys ❤️
the boys were jumping on the bed when you scored. almost fell off lol
haha crazy. careful with those beds. see you early tomorrow
YOURE THE BEST LEO I LOVE YOU COPA AMERICA CHAMPIONS 🏆🏆🏆
i cant believe it. i love you. this is for you, for the boys, for everyone
i cried the whole game. the boys are awake. thiago understood everything. mateo and ciro had no idea what was happening but they jumped anyway lol
lol i can picture you and the boys. so beautiful. coming home soon. still in the locker room with the guys
leo... i watched the game. please dont blame yourself
i should have passed you that ball. it was the goal. im sorry
baby, we all lost not just you. the team didnt play well. stop thinking about it
i know youre right. but it hurts. love you. talk tomorrow
the boys want to go to argentina this summer. what do you think?
yeah. sounds good. they need to see the family
also the world cup is in december. youre already thinking about that right?
yeah. its my dream. the last thing i need
WORLD CHAMPIONS LEO I LOVE YOU BEST IN HISTORY 🇦🇷🇦🇷🇦🇷🏆🏆🏆
i cant... i dont know what to say. i love you. this is all for you. for the boys. for argentina ❤️🇦🇷
i cried the whole game. after dibu's penalty save i screamed so loud i woke up the neighbors lol
haha so you. the boys? they were watching?
yeah all of them. thiago cried. mateo didnt understand much but screamed anyway. ciro fell asleep in the second half lol
leo, the people on the streets is incredible. miles of people. i cant believe it
its a lot. i didnt know it was like this. got emotional a few times
is it true what the newspapers are saying? youre going to miami??
yeah. already talked to the league people. i want you all to come with me
leo... thats crazy. but if youre happy then i am too. the boys will adapt. they always do
i know. we talked about this. miami is good for us. for the kids. for you
just saw your presentation. you look so happy leo. like a kid again 😊
i am happy. this feels right. like a new beginning for all of us
debut goal!!! i knew you would score. the whole stadium was screaming your name
haha yeah. the fans here are amazing. felt good to be back on the pitch
ciro just told me he wants to be a goalkeeper like dibu. im dying lol
haha no way. he changes positions every week. last week he wanted to be like me
thats our boy. cant make up his mind. just like his father lol
lol yeah. but i love him. love all of them. and you ❤️
happy birthday baby! 37 years old. i remember when you were just a kid from rosario 🥰
thank you amor. crazy how time flies. feels like yesterday we were kids in rosario
the boys made you cards. thiagos says best dad in the world. mateos has a drawing of you lifting the world cup. ciro colored all over his lol
thats the best gift ever. i love them. i love you. see you tonight ❤️
the boys are loving miami. theyre already asking when we can go to the beach again
good. thats what i wanted. for them to be happy. for us to be happy
we are leo. we really are. thank you for always putting us first ❤️
always. you and the boys are everything. forever ❤️
